language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language for the app and the agent's answers. A change applies to every open window at once.
language.saveFailed: Could not change the language: {{error}}. Try again in a moment.
language.agentNote: Ongoing conversations answer in the new language from their next turn.

browser.resetFailed: Couldn't clear the sign-in data. Close the browser window and try again.
browser.title: Built-in browser
browser.description: The app's own browser, used when the agent reads web pages or uses sites such as sound effect generators.
browser.about1: The agent works in a separate Browser window of the app, opening its own tabs for each session. You can watch and use the same window yourself.
browser.about2: Sites you sign in to in that window are shared by all projects and sessions, and stay signed in after you reopen the app.
browser.about3: The agent never enters passwords or payment details. Sign in yourself in the browser window.
browser.resetDescription: Signs you out of every site and deletes the files the browser downloaded. Only possible while the browser window is closed.
browser.resetDone: Sign-in data cleared. You'll need to sign in again the next time the browser window opens.
browser.confirmDescription: You'll be signed out of every site in the built-in browser, and the files it downloaded will be deleted. This applies to all projects and sessions and can't be undone.
browser.unsupportedTitle: The built-in browser is available on Windows only
browser.unsupportedDescription: On this platform the agent has no browser tools. Put files downloaded from the web in the project folder or attach them to a message.

dialog.title: Settings
dialog.description: Manage the native project, compile tools, AI providers, and confirmation notifications.

project.title: Native project
project.description: Switch projects, or import and export E3S compatibility files.
project.exportNote: Export to E3S saves an epScript project as an EUD Editor 3 project. Projects with Python sources can't be exported. The native project is the source of truth, and the EUD Editor runtime isn't used.

providers.detailDescription: Manage the connection status and the default model for new sessions.
providers.autosaved: Changes are saved immediately in each field.
providers.title: AI providers
providers.pick: Choose a provider to configure. Only its connection and model options are shown.
providers.defaultNote: The default provider applies to new sessions only. Existing EPS and Map sessions and harness jobs keep their provider.
providers.deepPlanningNote: Each plan makes several extra model calls, which greatly increases token usage.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Get notified so you don't miss a moment that needs your confirmation.

agentTurnComplete.title: Agent turn finished
agentTurnComplete.description: When an agent turn finishes, except for plan review

askResponseRequired.title: ASK answer needed
askResponseRequired.description: When the agent is waiting for your answer to a question

planApproval.title: Plan approval needed
planApproval.description: When a new or revised plan arrives

reviewRequired.title: Changes ready for review
reviewRequired.description: When a document change or Map candidate prepared by the harness is waiting for review

euddraft.title: euddraft compiler
euddraft.description: Check the install path and the managed distribution version, and update to the latest official release.
euddraft.missing: The configured euddraft can't be found. Choose the path again on the setup screen.
euddraft.manual: The version of a distribution you picked yourself can't be detected automatically. Install the latest managed distribution to compare versions automatically from then on.

mapvault.title: MapVault
mapvault.description: The connection the agent uses to create maps, versions and saved fields through the MapVault maker API, install the SDK and manage player data. Releasing, uploading a map file and changing player data are always asked on a confirmation card first.
mapvault.addressHint: The default is https://sc.mi3.dev. Only https addresses work; http works only for a development server on this computer (localhost, 127.0.0.1).
mapvault.apiKeyHint: Enter a key created in the MapVault site settings (it starts with mv_). The key is stored only in the OS credential store, and the agent can't see it.
mapvault.keySaved: Using the saved key · enter a new one to replace it
mapvault.keyMissing: No key is saved. The MapVault tools don't work until you enter one.
mapvault.readOnly: This is a read-only key. It can only read map and player information; it can't install the SDK or change versions, schemas or player data. To do that, create a regular key in the site settings and enter it here.

error.mapvault_address_invalid: The site address isn't valid. Enter an address that starts with https://, without a path or query. http works only for localhost and 127.0.0.1.
error.mapvault_key_format: That isn't an API key. Paste the key starting with mv_ exactly as the MapVault site settings showed it.
error.mapvault_key_store: Couldn't access the OS credential store.
error.mapvault_key_invalid: This API key isn't valid for this site. Check the key and the site address. Nothing was saved.
error.mapvault_unreachable: Can't reach the site. Check the site address and your network. Nothing was saved.
error.mapvault_unavailable: This address didn't answer as the MapVault API. Check the site address or try again in a moment. Nothing was saved.

error.jev_key_invalid: The API key isn't valid. Check the key.
error.jev_unreachable: Can't reach the TypeSafe server. Check your network.
error.jev_unavailable: The TypeSafe server couldn't handle the request. Try again in a moment.
error.jev_key_missing: Enter an API key to turn this on.
error.jev_key_store: Couldn't access the OS credential store.

jev.title: Jev document search reranking
jev.description: When on, search queries and document chunks are sent to the TypeSafe server.
jev.keySaved: Using the saved key · enter a new one to replace it

scmdraft.description: The "Open in SCMDraft 2" button at the top opens the source map with this executable.

starcraft.description: Map rendering, the minimap, and blank map creation read tileset data from this install folder.

mapTest.title: Map runtime tests
mapTest.description: Plays the built map headless in an emulator (sc4j): every build is checked for crashes and hangs, and the agent can check behaviour with test scripts (tests/*.mtest). Windows only.
mapTest.unsupported: Map runtime tests are available on Windows only.
mapTest.notInstalled: Turning this on downloads about {{size}} MB of runtime files.
mapTest.downloading: Downloading the map runtime test files
